newsitem.title: THAILAND: Krupp says ASEAN focus of Asia growth.
newsitem.headline: Krupp says ASEAN focus of Asia growth.

text.p: Germany's Krupp group said on Monday it expects South East Asia to be the primary focus of the company's expansion in the Asian region.

"The long term plan is to put nearly one third of our business into ASEAN nations," said Heribert J Wiedenhues, chairman of the executive board of Krupp Fordertechnik, a unit of Fried. Krupp AG Hoesch-Krupp's plant making division Krupp Anlangenbrau GmbH.

The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) groups Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore, the Philippines, Indonesia, Brunei and Vietnam. Krupp now maintains a presence in all the ASEAN countries, except Brunei.
He told Reuters the company would concentrate on automotive components, plant making and alloy steel manufacturing in the region and globally.

He said the company would select investment sites in Southeast Asia primarily on the basis of tax incentives but said Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines and Thailand topped its priority growth sites in the region.
